composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114a, "BILGE SYSTEM") serves the vessel's bilge equipment: the Main Bilge Pump (motor at top of sheet, fed via F3 60A, SW8, SO6, local pump switch — matching established main-bilge-pump identity), the Bilge Valves (Burkert electric rotary actuators, five OPEN/CLOSE motorized valve blocks captioned "BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE" wired via Re1-Re5/T/S C to Main Panel PLUG C and ONYX status taps), and the six bilge level sensors/switches (Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker Bilge SW) which are the sensing devices of the Bilge & Fire System card. Shared terminal strips (T/S S, T/S B, T/S C), the relay bank Re1-Re6, PLUG C/D, and the MAIN PANEL PC CARD are infrastructure of the Vessel Control Panel (641) and ONYX monitoring (652), not equipment in themselves.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Motor labeled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' at top of sheet, fed by F3 60A fuse, SW8 switch, SO6 (solenoid contactor), local pump switch via T/S S terminals 13/14/15. Matches established main-bilge-pump multi-switch activation control loop.

functions.label: Local/remote pump run command
functions.what_it_does: Runs the main bilge pump motor on command from any of three activation sources feeding the T/S S coil terminals (13/14/15), consistent with previously established multi-switch control loop.

flow_scenarios.path: +24V service battery -> F3 60A fuse -> SW8 -> SO6 solenoid contactor -> pump motor (idle until coil energised)
LOCAL PUMP SW closes -> T/S S terminal 13/14 -> SO6 coil energises -> contactor closes -> pump motor runs
MAIN PANEL bilge pump switch S13 -> PLUG C pins 6/7 -> T/S C terminals 48/49/50 -> relay Re6 -> T/S S coil -> pump motor runs
ONYX remote command via cable tagged XA11<32> -> terminal 50 -> relay Re6 -> T/S S coil -> pump motor runs

functions.dry_data: 24V DC motor, fed via F3 60A fuse and SW8; coil control via T/S S terminals 13/14/15; multi-source activation (local/main panel/ONYX)
functions.sheet_region: top of sheet (motor bbox ~0.85,0.06) and T/S S bbox [0.3,0.1,0.46,0.15]

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Five identical motor-driven OPEN/CLOSE valve blocks each captioned 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' with [2]/[3] motor terminals, wired through relays Re1-Re5 and T/S C to Main Panel PLUG C (open/closed status) and ONYX status taps (XA40/XA10). Matches established Burkert electric rotary actuator bilge valves.

functions.label: Remote open/close valve control per bilge zone
functions.what_it_does: Opens or closes each of the five bilge suction valves on command from the Main Panel, with open/closed status reported back to the Main Panel PC card indicators and to ONYX monitoring via status taps.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge Valves fed via breaker Q14 10A (EMERGENCY POWER SUPPLY/EMERGENCY PANEL, per established fact) -> valve actuator motors idle
MAIN PANEL PLUG C pin 1 [LAZARETTE BILGE] -> OPEN contact -> T/S C terminals 7/9 -> Re1 relay -> valve motor [2]/[3] opens
MAIN PANEL PLUG C pin 1 -> CLOSE contact -> T/S C terminal 8/10 -> Re1 relay -> valve motor closes
valve position -> T/S C terminals 13/14 -> XA40<14>/XA40<12> status taps -> ONYX monitoring; also -> Main Panel PC card open/closed indicator lamp
PLUG C pin 2 -> OPEN/CLOSE T/S C terminals 16/17 -> Re2 -> valve motor; status -> T/S C terminal 22/23 -> XA40<16> -> ONYX + PC card lamp

flow_scenarios.state: similar loop for valve 3 (ENG. ROOM BILGE)
flow_scenarios.path: PLUG C pin 3 -> OPEN/CLOSE T/S C terminals 24/25 -> Re3 -> valve motor; status -> T/S C terminal 30/31 -> XA10<06> -> ONYX + PC card lamp
PLUG C pin 4 -> OPEN/CLOSE T/S C terminals 32/33 -> Re4 -> valve motor; status -> T/S C terminal 38/39 -> XA10<04> -> ONYX + PC card lamp (open line 7 / closed line 8 on PC CARD)
PLUG C pin 5 -> OPEN/CLOSE T/S C terminals 40/41 -> Re5 -> valve motor; status -> T/S C terminal 46/47 -> XA10<02> -> ONYX + PC card lamp (open line 9 / closed line 10 on PC CARD)

functions.dry_data: Burkert electric rotary actuators on Burkert 2-way DN050 ball valves x5; fed via breaker Q14 10A per established fact; open/close command + open/closed status per valve via dedicated T/S C terminal pairs and XA-series status taps

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Six bilge switch devices (Port Lazarette, Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) drawn on right side of sheet, wired via dashed lines to the bilge valve controller blocks / T/S C bus; these are the sensing/alarm inputs of the overall bilge system card, not a standalone equipment node.

functions.label: Bilge water level detection per compartment
functions.what_it_does: Detects high bilge water level in each named compartment and feeds a signal back into the bilge valve control wiring / ONYX monitoring loop for alarm/status purposes.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge Sw (per compartment) open, no signal on dashed status line to valve controller / T/S C bus
Bilge Sw closes -> dashed signal line -> valve controller block wiring (shared conductor with valve status) -> T/S C bus -> XA-series tap -> ONYX monitoring alarm

functions.dry_data: Level switch type not specified on this sheet; 24V DC signal loop shared with valve status wiring

infrastructure.system_name: Vessel Control Panel (Main Panel) — bilge control/indication section
facts: MAIN PANEL PLUG C (7 pins) carries per-zone OPEN/CLOSE commands to Lazarette Bilge, Aft Bilge, Eng. Room Bilge, Fwd Bilge, Sail Locker valves plus bilge pump switch S13 lines.

MAIN PANEL PC CARD hosts open/closed indicator lamps (circled-X symbols) for each bilge valve zone (lines 7-10 shown: open/closed FWD BILGE, open/closed SAIL LOCKER; similar for other zones), diode array, +24V supply.
PLUG D (12-pin) connects Main Panel to Pedestal Alarm+Mute module (ALARM MOD) for audible bilge alarm and mute function.
Indicator switches S20 (Lazarette Bilge), S21 (Aft Bilge), S22 (Eng Room Bilge), S23 (Fwd Bilge), S24 (Sail Locker), S13 (Bilge Pump SW) are Main Panel front-panel controls.

infrastructure.system_name: ONYX Monitoring taps on bilge circuit
facts: Status taps XA40<14>, XA40<12>, XA40<16>, XA10<06>, XA10<04>, XA10<02> pull valve position/status signals from T/S C terminals into ONYX monitoring.

XA11<32> is a command/activation line into terminal 50 -> Re6, used by ONYX to remotely trigger the main bilge pump (per established control_loop fact), confirming this tap is an ACTIVATION path not a pure status tap.
'to ONYX' annotation near terminal 13/XA1 region is an unresolved off-sheet pointer to the ONYX system — direction/purpose not fully traceable on this sheet alone.

infrastructure.system_name: Terminal strip / relay bank infrastructure (T/S S, T/S B, T/S C, Re1-Re6)
facts: T/S S (3-way) carries local pump switch wiring to the main bilge pump SO6 coil.
T/S B (fused terminals 8-13) distributes supply from BILGE VALVES breaker Q13 10A to relays Re1-Re6.
T/S C is the main 50-terminal strip routing OPEN/CLOSE commands and status lines between Main Panel PLUG C, relays Re1-Re5/Re6, and the five bilge valve controller blocks plus bilge pump loop.

Bilge Valves fed via breaker Q13 10A per this sheet's own label 'BILGE VALVES Q13 10A' at T/S B — note: established register cites Q14 10A elsewhere for bilge valves electrical_supply; this sheet's own label reads Q13, flagged as a discrepancy for reconciliation.
